metadataRaw.title: How to Fix a Tight Buttock for Good
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to fix a tight buttock for good. Get fast relief from a tight, achy glutes in as little as 30 SECONDS!

This video is broken up into an EASY, three part step-by-step guide that will help fix buttock tightness and pain. 

First, we'll focus on loosening up muscle knots, spasms, trigger points, strain, and cramps in the glutes through a self massage. This will help offer quick RELIEF around the butt. 

Second, we'll focus on buttock activation stretches to help lengthen glute muscles. This should help us get more FLEXIBILITY and MOBILITY back in the lower back, hips, pelvis, and legs.

Third, to get rid of a tight buttock for good, we need to strengthen the glute muscles (including gluteus maximus and gluteus medius). We'll do this with simple, EFFECTIVE exercises that will help build strength and endurance in and around the buttocks, which may help stop future aches, pains, and tightness. 

All of these glute stretches and exercises are SAFE, natural movements that can be done at home or work. Best part is, no fancy equipment is needed either!

WATCH NOW and fix a tight butt for good!
